==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|:inh|sla-pro:*měna}}
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*měna}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|меня́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-менять.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|меня́ть|impf|pf=поменя́ть,обменя́ть}}

# to [[swap]], to [[barter]] (to give something to another person and take something in return)
# to [[replace]], to [[substitute]] or [[supersede]] (to get rid of an old thing or person and get a new one)
# to [[modify]], to [[change]], to [[transform]], to [[alter]] (to make something different gradually)
# to [[exchange]], to [[recapture]] (to lose one or more pieces or pawns almost simultaneously with the opponent)

====Conjugation====
{{ru-conj|impf|1a+p|меня́ть}}

====Derived terms====
* ''See {{m|ru|-мени́ть}} for derived verbs.''

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*rǫbiti}}. Compare {{cog|be|руба́ць}}, {{cog|bg|ръ́бя}}, {{cog|uk|руби́ти}}, {{cog|cs|roubit}}, {{cog|pl|rąbać}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|руби́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-рубить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|руби́ть|impf|pf=поруби́ть}}

# to [[axe]], to [[fell]], to [[chop]], to [[cut]] {{q|with an axe}}
# to [[build]] out of [[wood]]
#* {{quote-book|ru|year=1905|author=w:ru:Фёдор Сологуб<t:{{w|Fyodor Sologub}}>
|title=w:ru:Мелкий бес|chapter=XXIII|location=|publisher=|newversion=English translation from|translator2=John Cournos and Richard Aldington|title2=w:[[The Petty Demon|The Little Demon]]|location2=New York|publisher2=w:en:Alfred A. Knopf|year2=1916|page2=|pageurl2=
|text=Е́ле ви́дная сквозь пыль, подыма́лась, росла́ деревя́нная стена́. '''Руби́ли''' кре́пость.|t=Barely visible through the dust, a wooden wall loomed and grew. They '''were building''' a fortress.}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial|figurative}} to not [[mince words]], to [[speak]] the [[truth]], to [[speak]] one's [[mind]]
#: {{ux|ru|[[он|Он]] [[любить|лю́бит]] '''руби́ть''' [[правда|пра́вду]]-[[матка|ма́тку]].|t=He does'''n't''' like to '''mince words'''.|lit=He likes to '''cut''' the mother truth.}}
